SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s probably this way—on the right.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: احتمالاً از این طریق است - در سمت راست.

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: ...有情小姐，你一点都不害怕吗？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: …ユジョンさん、怖くないんですか？

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You don’t look scared at all…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 看起来完全不怕的样子...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 全然怖そうに見えないですけど…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi mukamu nggak kelihatan takut sama sekali…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você não parece ter medo nenhum...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No pareces tener miedo en absoluto...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 어두운 데서 일 많이 해 봤어서 막 엄청 그렇게 무섭진 않아요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve worked in a lot of dark places, so it doesn’t really freak me out anymore.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 因为在黑暗的地方工作惯了，倒不至于特别害怕
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 因為我常在黑暗的地方工作，所以沒有特別害怕
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 暗いところでの仕事多かったから、そんなに怖くはないです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku udah sering kerja di tempat gelap, jadi udah biasa aja sekarang.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu já trabalhei bastante em lugares escuros, então não me assusta tanto.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: He trabajado mucho en lugares oscuros, así que no me asusta tanto.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من در بسیاری از مکان‌های تاریک کار کرده‌ام، بنابراین دیگر واقعاً من را نگران نمی‌کنه.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 뭔가 유정 씨 덕에 조금 창피해졌어요...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’re kinda making me feel embarrassed now…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你这样说，我反而有点丢脸了...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 感覺因為有情小姐的關係，有點丟臉...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんかユジョンさん見てたら、ちょっと恥ずかしくなってきました…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você me deixa um pouco envergonhado...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Haces que me sienta un poco avergonzado...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: الان یه جورایی باعث میشی من خجالت بکشم…

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 제가 덩치값 너무 못하는 거 같아서...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I feel like I’m totally not living up to my size…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 觉得自己白长这么大个子了...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我的體型和膽量好像不成正比...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: この体格のわりに、全然頼りなくて…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ngerasa kayak badanku gede, tapi nyaliku kecil banget…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Porque, tipo, eu tô vivendo a minha vida...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Porque como estoy viviendo mi vida...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: احساس میکنم اصلا به اندازه خودم نیستم…
